name: WARNING: Terminal Crispy Nachos with Yellow Cheese Sauce & Pickled Jalapeños
whyItWorks: Hard, razor-sharp corn tortilla chips that shatter into jagged shards, smothered in hydrogenated cheese sauce and fiery pickled jalapeño wheels with seeds. Severe mechanical scrape hazard and acute capsaicin motility trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip stadium-style terminal nachos. Choose plain potato crisps or soft pretzels.
